note: GetRegion and GetStore carry the discovered cluster identity, validate response headers before projection, preserve raw peer/store fields, and try each current direct PD endpoint at most once only after Unavailable, DeadlineExceeded, Cancelled, or local timeout. Other gRPC application statuses and application/header/topology errors remain terminal. Router-service selection, generic retry/backoff, forwarding, the remaining PD methods, metrics, and tracing remain external.

The checked key lookup projects region, epoch, leader, peer order, every raw source peer-role discriminant and witness bit, and down-peer identities into a transport-neutral model without rejecting forward enum values. Streaming QueryRegion, batching, router-service selection, bucket ownership, and asynchronous routing remain external.

Synchronous requests cross one dedicated runtime worker whose endpoint-keyed tonic client map reuses channels. Foreground failover is deterministic and bounded to one operation attempt per known endpoint; application/header/topology errors remain terminal. Request pooling, client-context cancellation, tracing, batching, and async wait metrics remain external.

The bounded client exposes one explicit per-endpoint deadline and deliberately omits retry budgets, backoff, forwarding, TLS, router-client, follower-handle, metrics, TSO, and dynamic options. Broader option parity remains external.

Construction accepts one or more plaintext seeds, validates every confirmed nonzero response identity, skips per-seed RPC/header/zero-ID/incomplete-topology observations, and retains the last complete same-cluster GetMembers snapshot. Foreground refresh tries every known URL without erasing the last complete snapshot, normalizes/sorts/deduplicates member URLs, and records the leader. Background update/health loops, callbacks, TLS, forwarding, and service-mode changes remain external.
